text: エナちゃん　きょうは　かてると　いいね

structure.jp: きょうは　かてると　いいね
structure.en: it'd be nice if we can win today

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb plus と いい means 'it would be good if', which is how you say 'I hope'. かてると　いい = 'I hope we can win'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる makes it 'can do'. かてる = 'can win'.
